character_profile_valid.name: character_profile_valid
character_profile_valid.value: length("characters"."short_description") <= 500 and length("characters"."archetype") <= 120 and length("characters"."origin") <= 500 and length("characters"."personal_goal") <= 500 and length("characters"."dm_notes") <= 2000 and length("characters"."appearance") <= 1000 and length("characters"."quote") <= 300

inventory_items_character_catalog_bag_un.name: inventory_items_character_catalog_bag_unique
inventory_items_character_catalog_bag_un.where: "inventory_items"."catalog_item_id" is not null and "inventory_items"."equipped_slot" is null

inventory_item_equipped_valid.name: inventory_item_equipped_valid
inventory_item_equipped_valid.value: "inventory_items"."equipped_slot" is null or ("inventory_items"."catalog_item_id" is not null and "inventory_items"."quantity" = 1)

knowledge_visibility_target_valid.name: knowledge_visibility_target_valid
knowledge_visibility_target_valid.value: ("knowledge_entries"."visibility" = 'character' and "knowledge_entries"."visible_to_character_id" is not null) or ("knowledge_entries"."visibility" != 'character' and "knowledge_entries"."visible_to_character_id" is null)

knowledge_fact_reveal_target_valid.name: knowledge_fact_reveal_target_valid
knowledge_fact_reveal_target_valid.value: ("knowledge_fact_reveals"."audience" = 'party' and "knowledge_fact_reveals"."character_id" is null) or ("knowledge_fact_reveals"."audience" = 'character' and "knowledge_fact_reveals"."character_id" is not null)
